note: Seven import defects are fixed, and most of them move mass, length, balance point or stability - so re-open any RockSim or RASAero file you have imported. A RockSim mass object is a point at the position you gave it, not a body spread over the length RockSim happens to store, which on one design read a 7620 mm rocket for a 1652 mm airframe. A nose cone's base extension is no longer dropped, so 53 of 843 designs on hand stop importing up to 127 mm short. Every tube coupler and engine block used to weigh exactly nothing - their wall was applied before the part had a parent to take its diameter from - and a 4 inch coupler is now worth 27.4 g. Tube fin wall thickness reaches the physics engine instead of the airframe's wall being used. A RockSim transition keeps the curve the file states. RASAero fin cans and boat tails slide over and into the parts they belong to rather than being stacked on the end, which on one two-stage file was 9.2 percent too long and can turn a design that looked stable into one that is not. And an airfoil fin set this app writes into a .rkt no longer arrives in desktop OpenRocket weighing zero grams. Also: the launch rod exit speed was always flattering by 1.6 to 4.3 percent and is now read at the exact instant the rocket leaves the guide, and the descent rate is read straight from the physics engine.
